description: This file defines a Zustand store for managing attachment upload/download progress, encryption progress, and related state in the Notesnook mobile app. It includes types, store state, and methods for updating progress, removing attachments, and setting download/upload states.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an attachment by hash and updates the attachment progress to 100%

methods.name: setProgress
methods.description: Sets the upload or download progress for a specific attachment identified by hash

methods.name: setDownloading
methods.description: Updates the state of a downloading attachment group

methods.name: setUploading
methods.description: Updates the state of an uploading attachment group
